policy: REFERENCE_ONLY. Discovery does not approve, install, assign, invoke, or deliver skills. Promotion requires separate Board review and PR.

sources.note: Upstream is a full Claude Code studio template, not an Agent plugin. Never clone into Company OS or a game repo as a second studio root.

skills.value: Art Bible visual identity, palette, shape language and asset-standard review gates.
blockers: Upstream automatic Agent spawn and prompts depend on its own Claude project conventions.
Company OS visual identity and asset-production rules remain canonical; extract only useful checklists.
No task write permission or artwork generation granted.
skills.migration: Propose a reviewed Studio Skill excerpt with cited origin, adapted Company OS source paths and approval gates; no copy of upstream hooks or subagent topology.

skills.value: Entity and screen inventory, per-character asset specification and handoff checklist.
blockers: Upstream design paths and templates do not match Company OS or Deckbound.
Generates prompt text; never authorize model/image generation or asset writes.
Needs Board-scoped write set, rights and asset provenance checks.
skills.migration: Adapt specification checklist only after coverage/duplication review against studio-art-identity-and-refinement and asset-production rules.

skills.value: Static structural and behavioral skill quality rubric that could strengthen Company OS validation.
blockers: Framework-specific file layout, hooks and rubric catalogs are not available to Company Agents.
No shell scripts from external repository may execute as part of this candidate preview.
Testing coverage is not proof of live Agent skill effectiveness.
skills.migration: Extract framework-independent checks into Company OS unit tests; verify utility on one existing Studio Skill before adoption.

skills.value: Multi-role combat pipeline from design to implementation and QA.
dependencies: game-designer, gameplay-programmer, ai-programmer, technical-artist, sound-designer and qa-tester subagents
blockers: Duplicates the Paperclip work intake, task ownership, role and review systems.
Subagent launch and write rules conflict with Company OS authorization and paused Cursor gates.
skills.migration: Do not port the orchestrator. Any future reuse is limited to individual combat-design checklist items under a separate Board decision.

skills.value: Read-only UX/HUD/pattern-library quality gate: accessibility, alignment with GDD and implementation readiness; returns APPROVED / NOT ASSESSED / NEEDS REVISION / MAJOR REVISION NEEDED.
dependencies: design/ux/ specifications or equivalent Task-local documents
project.yaml platform/input configuration or equivalent Company OS context
blockers: Native studio-ui-ux-review is proposed in PR #116; do not route upstream CCGS UX review as an active or equivalent skill.
Upstream file layout, platform configuration and UX templates may not be accessible from Paperclip Task Workspace.
Upstream skill status/verdict does not replace the independent Company OS review/approval stages.
User-scope ui-ux-pro-max and google-design-md already overlap in design research; review criteria should be distilled into a nonduplicative, read-only quality rubric.
skills.migration: Use the native skill only after separately approved merge and verified Knowledge Delivery; keep upstream as pinned method/provenance reference, not a parallel skill.
